headline: Nvidia drama drags tech lower
context: Chip stocks slid again after Nvidia's CEO quit, but most other stocks rose and the Dow edged up.
chart_title: Tech fell, almost everything else rose

CHTR.text: No company news. Cable peer Comcast rose 1.5%.

STE.text: Jefferies upgraded it, saying a year of worries has left the shares cheaper than usual.

GPN.text: Payment stocks rose together (FIS +4.2%, Fiserv +3.7%), a rebound after its recent sell-off.

AMD.text: Early gains flipped into an AI chip sell-off as investors worried about Nvidia without its CEO.

DELL.text: No company news. AI hardware stocks sold off; SanDisk and Western Digital fell about 5%.

CSCO.text: Record sales, but next quarter's forecast came in lower, and Citi said growth may have peaked.

watch.title: Nvidia earnings
watch.text: Its first results since Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO.

watch.title: Anthropic IPO
watch.text: Could be the largest stock market debut on record.

question: Does a CEO leaving change how you see a company?
